{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"LIFE-209: re-send SMS messages that failed at the gateway last cycle.

Reads the gateway's delivery status, finds every sent message whose status is
"failed", and queues one identical re-send (same household, template and
params) for each. Delivered messages are left alone. Opted-out households
(queue_sms raises ValueError) are reported and skipped, not fatal.

Idempotent: if a failed message has already been re-sent (an outbox line with
the same household_id/template_id/params queued after the original), it is
skipped so running the script twice never double-texts a household.
"""

import sys

from audit.log import record
from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages

ACTOR = "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py"


def main() -> int:
    status = delivery_status()
    failed_ids = {sid for sid, result in status.items() if result == "failed"}
    messages = sent_messages()
    by_id = {m.id: m for m in messages}

    # Signatures of messages queued after the originals: if a failed message was
    # already re-sent, its re-send appears in the outbox with a new id (and no
    # status entry). Match on household/template/params to skip it.
    resent_signatures = {
        (m.household_id, m.template_id, tuple(sorted(m.params.items())))
        for m in messages
        if m.id not in status
    }

    sent, skipped_resent, opted_out = [], [], []
    for sid in sorted(failed_ids):
        original = by_id.get(sid)
        if original is None:
            print(f"{sid}: failed status but no sent message found; skipped")
            continue
        sig = (original.household_id, original.template_id,
               tuple(sorted(original.params.items())))
        if sig in resent_signatures:
            skipped_resent.append(sid)
            print(f"{sid}: already re-sent; skipped")
            continue
        try:
            msg = queue_sms(original.household_id, original.template_id, original.params)
        except ValueError as exc:
            opted_out.append(sid)
            print(f"{sid}: not re-sent ({exc})")
            continue
        resent_signatures.add(sig)
        sent.append(msg)
        print(f"{sid}: re-sent as {msg.id} to {msg.household_id}")

    if sent:
        record("sms_batch", ACTOR, ref="LIFE-209-resend-failed-sms")

    print(f"\nre-sent: {len(sent)}, already re-sent: {len(skipped_resent)}, "
          f"opted out: {len(opted_out)}, "
          f"delivered (untouched): {sum(1 for r in status.values() if r == 'delivered')}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
